items.difficulty_reason: The non-routine construction tensors an independent-set pseudo-expectation and uses covering/eigenvalue properties to enforce coloring sum constraints without a pointwise complete reduction. The full local argument transfers the random-graph lower bound while preserving the original instance and weaker multiple-color-class model.
